result:
Each query is untested; I wrote them from the documentation page alone.

Q1: Keep active users whose lowercased city is "berlin", then take their emails and sort.
Q2: Keep orders with status "paid", multiply price by qty over their items, sum, and round to 2 places.
Q3: Keep open issues, group by assignee with null replaced by "unassigned", and count each group.
Q4: Union the two dependency maps, keep entries whose version starts with "^", take the names and sort.
Q5: Split each line into fields, keep status ≥ 500, take the paths, dedupe and sort.
Q6: Parse the CSV rows, drop empty salaries, group by dept, then average and round each group.
Q7: Lowercase every value, dedupe and count.
Q8: Keep enabled services, build name and port records (port defaults to 80), sort by port descending then name, and format as "name:port".
Q9: Group events by user and count, turn into records, sort by count descending then user, and take 3.
Q10: Sort by comments (missing counts as 0) descending then id, take 3, and return the titles.
Q11: Trim lines, keep those starting with "DB_", and build a map from the lowercased key part to the value (rejoined after the first "=").
Q12: Keep orders with total over 100 and check that every one has a non-null shipped_at.
Q13: Flatten all tags (null or missing as empty), lowercase, dedupe and sort.
Q14: Group by endpoint, keep groups with at least 2 records, build the count and rounded average latency (nulls ignored), and sort by endpoint.

Q1: filter ~(/active | and (at :address | coalesce {} | at :city | coalesce "" | lower | eq "berlin")) | * /email | sort ~(/)
Q2: filter ~(/status | eq "paid") | * /items | flat | * (mul /price /qty) | sum | round 2
Q3: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(/assignee | coalesce "unassigned") * count
Q4: /dependencies | union /devDependencies | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | * (/0 | keyword) | sort ~(/)
Q5: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * split " " | filter ~(/3 | parseJson | gte 500) | * /2 | distinct | sort ~(/)
Q6: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * split "," | filter ~(/2 | count | gt 0) | groupBy ~(/1) * (* (/2 | parseJson) | avg | round 1)
Q7: * lower | distinct | count
Q8: filter ~(/enabled | eq true) | * {:name /name :port (at :net | coalesce {} | at :port | coalesce 80)} | sort ~([(/port | desc) /name]) | * (:r / | /name | append ":" | append (r | /port | print))
Q9: groupBy ~(/user) * count | entries | * {:user (/0 | keyword) :count /1} | sort ~([(/count | desc) /user]) | take 3
Q10: sort ~([(at :comments | coalesce 0 | desc) /id]) | take 3 | * /title
Q11: lines | * trim | filter ~(startsWith "DB_") | * [(split "=" | /0 | drop 3 | lower | keyword) (split "=" | drop 1 | join "=")] | tag ::map
Q12: filter ~(/total | gt 100) | every ~(/shipped_at | ne null)
Q13: * (at :tags | coalesce []) | flat | * lower | distinct | sort ~(/)
Q14: groupBy ~(/endpoint) | filter ~(count | gt 1) | entries | * {:endpoint (/0 | keyword) :count (/1 | count) :avgMs (/1 | filter ~(at :latency_ms | ne null) | * /latency_ms | avg | round 0)} | sort ~(/endpoint)
